lines: Staff can now flag a member for attention, or suspend them, always with a reason.
Each row that can be moderated has one action, and shows its note under the status.
Moderate opens a dialog. Flag is chosen first, the milder step. A note is all it needs.
A toast confirms it, and the list shows the member flagged, with the note.
Suspend asks for more: the note, and a confirmation that their sessions will end.
Leave something out, and the dialog names it before anything is sent.
On the server, suspending ends every session in the same save, and sign-in is refused in both apps.
Nobody moderates their own account, and only an Admin moderates staff. Each refusal has its own code.
Every test failed first. Now they all pass.
That's slice twenty-seven point one. Christian Fitness: a Christian community for health in body and spirit.
